stem:
Consider the following pairs : (River) (Flows into)
1. Mekong Andaman Sea
2. Thames Irish Sea
3. Volga Caspian Sea
4. Zambezi Indian Ocean
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
expl: Volga is the longest river in Europe carrying largest volume of water. It drains into Caspian Sea. Zambezi River either crosses or runs along the borders of six countries - Angola, Zambia, Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe and Mozambique and finally drains into Indian Ocean. Thames River originates in the Cotswold Hills and drains into North Sea. Mekong is the longest river in Southeast Asia. It drains into the South China Sea.

stem: The largest river of the world in terms of drainage area, is-
expl: South America’s Amazon River is the largest river in terms of its volume of flow in the world. Its drainage area is about 70 lakhs square km. and its length is approximately 6,437 km. In terms of length, the longest river of the world is the Nile which flows in East Africa far a distance of 6,695km. Congo River flows in Central Africa and covers a distance of about 4,374 km crossing the equator twice during its flow. Its drainage area is about 3822000 square km. Mississippi-Missouri river system is located in North America and it is the largest river system in North-America.

stem: Which one of the following rivers is the second longest river of the world?
expl: Amazon River in South America is the largest and the second longest river in the world after the Nile. The basin of Amazon belongs to Brazil, Peru, Bolivia, Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, French Guiana and Suriname.

stem: Which of the following rivers crosses the Equator twice?
expl: Congo River is also known as 'Zaire River' is the second largest river after the Amazon on the African continent. It crosses the Equator twice.

stem: Which one of the following is a part of the Congo Basin?
expl: According to World Wildlife Fund (WWF), the Congo Basin spans across six countries - Cameroon, Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Republic of the Congo, Equatorial Guinea and Gabon.

stem: Which one among the following rivers is the longest ?
expl: The world's three longest rivers and their respective lengths are given below : (River Name) (Length) Nile 6695 km Amazon 6437 km Yangtze 6300 km

stem: The longest river of South America –
expl: Amazon is the longest river in South America. This river is about 6437 km long. Ships can sail up to a distqance of 1,600 km. Apart from this, Nile (6,695 km) in Africa, Mississippi (3779 km) in U.S.A., and the Ganga (2,525 km) in India are the prominent rivers. In terms of length the Nile River is the longest river in the world. Countries like South Sudan, D.R. Congo, Ethiopia, Eritrea, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Burundi, Sudan and Egypt are part of drainage basin of the Nile River. Nile River, flows into the Mediterranean Sea.

stem: Which of the following countries is not under the drainage area of the Nile river-
expl: Countries like Burundi, Rwanda, D.R. Congo, Ethiopia, Sudan, South Sudan, Tanzania, Kenya, Eritrea, Uganda and Egypt are part of the drainage basin of the Nile river. 'Chad’ does not come under the drainage basin of River Nile. Therefore, option (a) is the correct answer.

stem: The Blue Nile river originates from
expl: The Blue Nile river originates from Lake Tana in Ethiopia. The upper course of the river is called the Abbay in Ethiopia.

stem: Consider the map given below : The river shown on the map is :
expl: Above map is related to Myanmar, On its eastern part from north to south, River Salween is shown to be flowing on the map. River Salween emerges from the Tibetan Plateau and covering a distance of 2,815 km falls into the Andaman Sea.

stem: Which one of the following rivers of Asia flows towards the south ?
expl: Amur flows towards north-east direction and Lena and Ob rivers flow towards the north from their origin while the Salween River flows towards the south from its origin.

stem: Which one of the following pairs (River — Direction) is not correctly matched?
expl: The Mekong River originated from the Tibetan Plateau (China) and flows southeast for about 4900 to 5000 km. before emptying into South China Sea. This river flows through China, Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia and Vietnam. - The Amur River flows northeast from its source and empties into the Pacific Ocean (Tartary Strait). - The Syr Darya River flows northwest from its source and empties into the Aral Sea. - The Angara River initially flows north from its source, then turns westward and merges with Yenisei River. The Yenisei River ultimately empties into the Arctic Ocean.

stem: The largest river of Asia is –
expl: The Yangtze river, with a length of 6,300 km., is the longest Asian river in Asia. It flows in China and falls into the East China Sea (Pacific Ocean). The lengths of other rivers are - Indus - 2880 km, Brahmaputra - 2900 km, Hwang Ho (Yellow River) - 5464 km.

List-I

3. Mackenzie 4. Amazon
5. Yukon
Code : A B C D
expl: Rivers A , B, C, & D mentioned in the given map are as follows: (A) Yukon River: It is major North American river that flows through the central Yukon Territory of northwestern Canada and the central region of Alaska a state of the U.S. (B) Mackenzie River: Rising out of Great Slave Lake, the Mackenzie River flows generally northwest in Canada. It finally empties into the Beaufort Sea, part of the Arctic Ocean, through the vast Mackenzie Delta. 1738 km. long Mackenzie river is the longest River in Canada. (C) Saint Lawrence River: This river connects Great Lakes to the Atlantic Ocean. It forms an international boundary between the United States of America and Canada. (D) Orinoco River: Approximately 65 percent of this river basin is in Venezuela and remaining portion is in Colombia. It is 2150 km long.

stem: Which of the following river flows through a rift valley ?
expl: The Rhine river emerges at the Swiss Alps and flowing through a rift valley empties into the North Sea. Famous German city Bonn is located on the banks of the river Rhine.

stem: In which sea do river Elbe and river Rhine drain their water?
expl: River Elbe and River Rhine drain their water in to the North Sea. Significantly, the Elbe is one of Europe's major rivers. The Elbe River Basin covers an area of approximately 1.5 lakh km2.

stem: Which of the following is not related to Asia?
expl: Lop Nor: Lop Nor is saline lake in China. Amur river : The length of the Amur river is 2897 (4440 km. if the Argun river is included). The Amur forms a border between Russia, Mongolia and China. Niger river: The Niger rises in the Fouta Djallon Highlands of Western Africa and empties into the Gulf of Guinea. It is related to Africa, not Asia. Tigris river: It rises in Taurus Mountains of eastern Turkiye. It meets Euphrates River in Iraq and merges into the Persian Gulf.

stem: Which of the following river of Africa crosses tropic of Capricorn twice?
expl: Limpopo river of Africa crosses tropic of Capricorn twice.

stem: The country which provides the best example of radial drainage is
expl: The southern central region of Sri Lanka is the tallest highland which rises to 1,500 metres above sea-level. The altitude decreases towards plains from this highland gradually. This plain is narrow in the western and southwestern regions and widest in the north. The rivers of Sri Lanka rise in the central highlands and flow in a radial pattern towards the sea. Most of these rivers are short. Mahaweli is the longest river in Sri Lanka. Flowing towards northeast, it merges into Bay of Bengal.

stem: Mahaweli Ganga is a river of –
expl: The rivers of Sri Lanka are short and flow in a radial pattern outwards from the central highlands. The Mahaweli river is the longest river (335 km) in Sri Lanka starting from the Hatton plateau on the western side of Sri Lanka and flowing into the Bay of Bengal.

stem: The great Asian river the Mekong does not flow through:
expl: The Mekong is a trans-boundary river in Southeast Asia. From the Tibetan Plateau, the river flows through China’s Yunnan province, Myanmar , Laos, Thailand, Cambodia and Vietnam and falls into South China Sea. The Mekong river does not flow through Malaysia.

stem: The glacial lake Itasca is the source of the river –
expl: Lake Itasca is the main source of river Mississippi. Ohio Arkansas, Red River etc. are tributaries of Mississippi. Mississippi flows into the Gulf of Mexico.

stem: At the mouth of which of the following rivers the 'bird's foot' type delta is formed ?
expl: At the mouth of River Mississippi, 'bird's foot' delta is formed.

stem: Grand Canyon of U.S.A. is formed by which of the following rivers ?
expl: The Grand Canyon is a vast, steep-sided canyon located in Arizona, United States of America, and it developed mainly due to erosion by the Colorado River. The main phase of its cutting/erosion is considered to have occurred within the last ~5–6 million years (about 50–60 lakh years). •The flow of the Colorado River, which carries large amounts of mud/silt, sand, and gravel, acts like sandpaper and, over millions of years, continuously cuts downward (downcutting) into the rock layers.
